compute_human_normalized_score: compute the human-normalized score for a given Atari game and raw score using get_human_normalized_score
list_atari_games: list all 57 Atari games available in the ATARI_GAMES tuple for benchmarking
lookup_atari_baseline_scores: lookup the random and human baseline scores for a specific Atari game from _ATARI_DATA
evaluate_agent_performance: evaluate an RL agent performance by comparing its raw score against human and random baselines
normalize_atari_scores: normalize a set of Atari game scores to the 0-1 human-normalized scale for cross-game comparison
